room.inn.title: Wayside Inn
room.inn.description: A low inn with a well-stocked board. The salt flats lie north; a long track leads east.
room.track.title: Long Track
room.track.description: A dusty track that runs on for miles. The inn lies west.
room.flats.title: Salt Flats
room.flats.description: White flats under an open sky. The inn lies south.
room.flats.drought: White flats under an open sky. No cloud, no shade; the dry air cracks your lips. The inn lies south.
item.bread.room: A [loaf of bread] sits on the board.
item.bread.description: A round brown loaf, still soft.
narration.hungry.applied: The long road leaves you hungry.
narration.thirsty.applied: The long road leaves you thirsty.
narration.parched.applied: The dry air parches your throat.
